description: The deployment that ADR 0152 §4.2's `theme.declaration` row exists to serve: only humans may mint the bundle-local Theme, while `theme.assignment` stays open so a tenant service can restyle the Theme the platform declared.
adrRow: §4.2 `theme.declaration` → `declareTheme` (ADR 0160 §5.1). Declaration and assignment are two handles because they are two authorities.
note: Enforcement lives in formspec-studio: `ProposalManagerFacade.declareTheme` calls the §5.2 check before any bundle read, and `theme.declare` maps to this handle on replay (`actor-posture-admission.ts`).
